question: What do Arbitrum One, Base and Solana offer a pool contract beyond the EVM baseline: Stylus, Timeboost, BoLD, fees, Flashblocks, and Token-2022 extensions, as of 2026-10-08?

frame.comparator: plain EVM contract on a rollup

item.title: docs.arbitrum.io: Stylus gentle introduction, Timeboost, BoLD, Arbitrum vs Ethereum comparison

findings.finding: Stylus adds a WASM virtual machine beside the EVM (Rust first-class, also C and C++); Solidity and Stylus contracts call each other; cost advantage is in compute and memory, "Storage operations cost roughly the same as in the EVM"; contracts must be activated and reactivated each 365 days or after an upgrade; "The Arbitrum Security Council has temporarily paused new Stylus contract activations on Arbitrum One and Arbitrum Nova."
findings.exactSourceLanguage: "Ink works like gas but is thousands of times smaller."

findings.finding: Timeboost: sealed-bid second-price auction for an express lane per round, round 60 seconds, non-express transactions delayed 200 ms by default, default reserve 0.001 WETH, proceeds to a beneficiary the chain owner designates; live on Arbitrum One and Nova.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: "the default duration of a round is 60 seconds."; "default 200-millisecond artificial delay"

findings.finding: BoLD: permissionless validation, anyone can open challenges, dispute window 6.4 days plus a 2-day Security Council grace period as stated, live on Arbitrum One, Nova and Sepolia.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: "allows anyone to participate in validating chain state (including challenges)."

findings.finding: Fees are an L2 execution component plus a component covering posting calldata to the parent chain.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: "Arbitrum transactions must also pay a fee component to cover the cost of posting their calldata to the parent chain"

findings.finding: Block 512,999,361; arbOSVersion() returns 116; getMinimumGasPrice() 20,000,000 wei (0.02 gwei); eth gas price 20,474,000 wei; getL1BaseFeeEstimate() 5,483,794 wei.

item.title: docs.base.org Flashblocks overview and Base Account page

findings.finding: Flashblocks: preconfirmations every 200 ms inside a 2 s block, built by the sequencer's base-builder; ordering is locked once a Flashblock is built and broadcast. The page does not say whether they are live on mainnet or how an app reads them over RPC.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: Flashblocks "reduce effective block times from 2 seconds to 200 milliseconds through preconfirmations."

findings.finding: The Base Account documentation has moved to the Coinbase Developer Platform and the SDK is now called the Coinbase Wallet SDK.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: "Base Account SDK and Base MCP documentation has moved from Base docs to Coinbase Developer Platform."

item.title: cast reads on Base mainnet (chain id 8453, 2026-10-08)
solana-program.com Token-2022 docs and extensions guide

findings.finding: Mint extensions: confidential transfers, transfer fees, interest-bearing tokens, non-transferable tokens, permanent delegate, transfer hook; account extension: default account state; extensions are opt-in at mint creation and combinable.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: "it's possible to create a mint with only transfer fees, only interest-bearing tokens, both, or neither!"

findings.finding: Interest-bearing is cosmetic: balances do not change, the displayed amount adds continuously compounded interest by network timestamp, and the rate authority can change the rate at any time.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: "No new tokens are ever created, the UI amount returns the amount of tokens plus all interest the tokens have accumulated."

findings.finding: Permanent delegate has unlimited privileges over any account of the mint (burn or transfer any amount) and does not work on confidential balances; transfer hook runs after other transfer logic and is skipped for self-transfers.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: "This authority has unlimited delegate privileges over any account for that mint"

notFound: confidential transfer limits and ZK program status (extension guide links to a separate page)
